summary: I rebuilt the outcome layout so every list keeps at least one full row in view in every ending, at any size the window allows (down to 560x600) and for any length of text. Each list now sits in a star row whose MinHeight is exactly one full row of that list. LargestFilesList moved out of LargestFilesPanel into its own row. Every text that grows with a path is bounded. With a list shown, the outcome's texts sit in a ScrollViewer whose row takes their natural height when there is room and shrinks to one line when there is not. The results header is one trimmed line. A largest file's location wraps to 3 lines at most, trimmed, with the full path as a tooltip. The results rows now trim instead of scrolling sideways. After an ending the outcome and the results list share the height 3:1, with minimums of 292 px and 84 px; together that is 376 px, which fits the 385 px left below the pickers at 560x600. Neither window minimum changed. The report gained additive `fullRows` keys for the three lists (rows wholly inside the list's viewport) and an `OutcomeTexts` key. New case B-008 runs a stopped scan of a 224-character root with the unreadable list closed and opened, at the window's minimum size. B-007 now checks full rows at both the default and the minimum size (the hook's sizing now sets MinWidth as well as MinHeight). All 26 non-network window cases pass, and so do real C:\ scans at 560x600 and 880x600.

files.why: Window-size rework. Outer Grid: outcome row 3* with MinHeight 292, results row 1* with MinHeight 84; each row is Auto while its panel is collapsed. Inner outcome Grid: the texts are in ScrollViewer OutcomeTexts, row OutcomeTextsRow is 100* while a list row is star and Auto otherwise, MinHeight 22, MaxHeight set from code. LargestFilesPanel keeps only the heading, caption and column headings (Auto). LargestFilesList has its own row (3*, MinHeight 56 while visible) and a path cell capped at 3 lines with CharacterEllipsis and a full-path tooltip. The expander row is 2* with MinHeight 74 while open; UnreadableList MinHeight goes from 24 to 41 to leave room for its horizontal scrollbar. TopLevelHeader is one trimmed line with the full text as tooltip. TopLevelList disables horizontal scrolling so its rows' TextTrimming takes effect. OutcomePanel stays VerticalAlignment=Top. Comments state what holds and under which measured conditions.

HideLargestFiles also collapses LargestFilesList, which no longer sits inside LargestFilesPanel. New OnOutcomeTextsSizeChanged sets OutcomeTextsRow.MaxHeight to the texts' natural height once they are laid out, and never below the row's MinHeight.

Adds keys under schema 1 without renaming any: window.OutcomeTexts {actualHeight, extentHeight, inView}, and fullRows on LargestFilesList, UnreadableList and TopLevelList (rows whose container lies wholly inside the list's ScrollContentPresenter). Schema doc updated.

FSA_HOOK_MINHEIGHT is renamed FSA_HOOK_MINSIZE. `size` mode and FSA_HOOK_MINSIZE now set Width=MinWidth as well as Height=MinHeight and log 'sized width=n minWidth=n height=n minHeight=n'. Once the ending is on screen, the report is held at Render priority until the drive buttons have loaded ('drives in ms=n held=n'), so it reads the tighter layout. Docs updated.

CheckBothLists now also requires fullRows >= 1 for every list shown and OutcomeTexts in view. CheckSized checks width and height and the drives line. The tree builder is factored out as New-TopsTree, and Invoke-StoppedEnding is shared by B-007 and B-008. B-007's second half runs at MinWidth x MinHeight. New B-008 is a stopped scan of a 224-character root at the minimum size with the unreadable list closed and opened; it also checks that the title and detail exceed 400 characters and that the texts scroll. B-003's two '>= 40 px' checks become fullRows >= 1. B-008 is added to the ValidateSet, $HookedCases and All, and the header is updated.

The window section now describes the 3:1 split with minimums (results list: header plus one full row, 84 px, at every allowed size), the one-line trimmed header, and the list no longer scrolling sideways.

deviations: A largest file's location wraps to at most 3 lines, ends in CharacterEllipsis, and carries the full path as its ToolTip. The earlier m1/O-018 wording was 'a long location is never clipped'. The new rule demands one full row for any text length, and a row with no height bound grows without limit with the path, so no window can promise a full row of it. The cap applies only past 3 lines: at 560 px width that is about 140 characters of path, and more at wider widths.

TopLevelHeader, an SL-039 control, is now one line with CharacterEllipsis and its full text as a ToolTip, where it used to wrap. It holds the root path, so wrapping made its height unbounded. TopLevelList, also SL-039, now sets ScrollViewer.HorizontalScrollBarVisibility="Disabled". Before, the Auto horizontal scrolling measured rows at infinite width, so SL-039's own TextTrimming never took effect, and a horizontal bar could take the one row's space.

The outcome's texts scroll only while a list row is shown. Their row is Auto in endings with no list ('Could not read', 'Scan failed'), which show their texts whole as before. The reason is a measured WPF bug: when every star row has a MaxHeight, Grid throws IndexOutOfRangeException in SetFinalSizeMaxDiscrepancy if it is given more than their sum. On the relative-root ending it was given 43.24000000000001 px against 43.24 px at most, and exited 70 (C-005 and L-003 failed until this was fixed). Endings with no list have no list for the rule to protect.

MinWidth (560) and MinHeight (600) are unchanged. The fix bounds text instead of raising the window's minimum, as the rework allowed. The two row minimums (292 + 84 = 376 px) fit in the 385 px below the pickers at 560x600 on this machine. They are measured constants, at 100% scaling, with the drive buttons on one line.

The report gained additive keys, window.OutcomeTexts and fullRows on the three lists, following the x:Name convention. 'At least one full row' cannot be read from heights alone; fullRows is the direct measure, and every B-case asserts it.

The hook variable FSA_HOOK_MINHEIGHT, from the previous attempt, is renamed FSA_HOOK_MINSIZE, and sizing now sets MinWidth too. Sized runs hold the report until the drive buttons are in. The rule is 'down to MinWidth x MinHeight', and the pickers' height depends on whether the buttons have loaded.
follow_ups: The row minimums are constants measured at 100% scaling with the drive buttons on one line, with 9 px to spare at 560x600. A machine whose drive buttons wrap to a second line at 560 px, or a larger text scale, would push the pair past 385 px. Neither was measured. Making the pickers' height independent of the drive count, for example a single scrolling row of buttons, would remove the dependency.

At the default 880x600 the outcome row sits at its 292 px minimum. A finished C:\ scan then shows 95 of its 129 px of texts with the list closed, and 54 px with it open; the rest is a scroll away. The results list keeps one full row (55 px). If the texts should show whole at the default size, a 4:1 split or a taller default window would do it. That is a balance choice, not a rule breach.

tests.command: pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tests/window/WindowCases.ps1 -Case All (first run on the new layout)
tests.note: C-005 and L-003 (relative root) exited 70 with no report. A temporary crash log in App.xaml.cs, since reverted and hash-checked, showed IndexOutOfRangeException in Grid.SetFinalSizeMaxDiscrepancy. The texts row was the only star row, with MaxHeight 43.24 px, and was arranged at 43.24000000000001 px. Two fixes that assumed Min>Max did not help, so the texts row is now Auto while no list row is star. The other 24 cases passed.

26 passed (C-001 to C-014, O-016, L-001 to L-003, B-001 to B-008). N-001 to N-004 were not run: they change SMB mappings. In every B-007 run at 880x600 and 560x600, and in both B-008 runs, each list had fullRows >= 1. B-008 at 560x600 with a 224-character root: title and detail 402 characters; texts 79 px (closed) or 38 px (opened) shown of 181.56 px; LargestFilesList 56 px, 1 full row; UnreadableList 41 px, 1 full row; TopLevelList 57.26 px, 1 full row.
Re-run on the final source after comment-only XAML edits, with the exe republished.
